name: LANKO 124 Ultraprime
paste:
LANKO 124 ULTRAPRIME: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: LANKO 124 Ultraprime, March 2025, Version 01.01 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/3/lanko-124-ultraprime.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide LANKO 124 Ultraprime where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (March 2025, Version 01.01).
1.2 Product description. LANKO 124 Ultraprime is a technologically advanced acrylic based multipurpose primer, for use prior to the application of Davco - Lanko mortar systems onto porous substrates. LANKO 124 Ultraprime increases the bond strength of cementitious mortar systems, such as Lanko floor levellers and Lanko patching and repair products.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer.
    - Internal and external wall and floor applications.
    - LANKO 124 Ultraprime can be applied over timber, concrete and most common porous building substrates prior to the application of Davco-Lanko floor levellers and patching and repair mortars systems.
    - LANKO 124 Ultraprime reduces the porosity of substrates by providing a consistent surface to regulate the drying of Davco Lanko mortar systems. The application of LANKO 124 Ultraprime prior to applying Davco Lanko floor levellers reduces pin-holing. LANKO 124 Ultraprime increases the adhesion of Lanko mortar systems.
1.4 Limits of use. Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.4.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. LANKO 124 Ultraprime
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: ACRYLIC BASED MULTIPURPOSE PRIMER FOR POROUS SUBSTRATES
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Approvals, certificates and standards stated by the manufacturer. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (March 2025, Version 01.01) has no approvals, certificates or standards section.
2.3 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - Very high bond strength
    - Can be applied over a variety of substrates
    - Reduces the porosity of substrates by providing a consistent surface to regulate the drying of Lanko mortar systems.
    - Use prior to levelling compounds and screeds
    - Low VOC
2.4 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Colour: White milky liquid that dries clear.
2.5 Properties stated by the manufacturer.
    - Flash point: Non flammable
2.6 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: 1 Litre Jerry can; 5 Litre Jerry Can; 20 Litre Pail
    - Shelf life: 12 Months from date of manufacture
    - Storage conditions: Store in dry cool conditions out of direct sunlight.

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 Substrate preparation. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (March 2025, Version 01.01) states no substrate preparation requirements.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (March 2025, Version 01.01) and the requirements below.
4.2 Application data.
    - Consumption: 1 Litre of LANKO 124 Ultraprime covers approximately 8 - 10m²; Surface texture and site conditions van impact the coverage of any particular installation.
4.3 Applied Product Ready for Use. LANKO 124 Ultraprime dries in appriximately 30 minutes. Climate and site conditions can impact drying time. LANKO 124 Ultraprime is a milky white colour and dries clear. Once the primer is clear flooring applications can commence.
4.4 Limitations and important considerations.
    - The use of LANKO 124 Ultraprime does not preclude good surface preparation practices. See substrate quality section.
    - Do not use on highly porous slabs, or in hot windy conditions without prior wetting down the slab – see application instructions.
    - Do not use when temperatures are below 5°C or above 35°C.
    - Do not apply if temperatures are expected to reach these levels within 24 hours of application.
    - For applications not mentioned on this data sheet, contact Sika Australia.

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, measure and record the conditions in clause 5.2 and compare them with the manufacturer's limits. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Conditions stated in the limitations. Also stated in the data sheet limitations (clause 4.4):
    - Do not use when temperatures are below 5°C or above 35°C.
    - Do not apply if temperatures are expected to reach these levels within 24 hours of application.
5.3 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.4 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: LANKO 124 Ultraprime, March 2025, Version 01.01, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/3/lanko-124-ultraprime.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SDS Various Semi-Finished, version 29/03/2026, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/j/sds-various-semi-finished-1.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SDS LANKO 124 Ultraprime, version 29/03/2026, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/c/sds-lanko-124-ultraprime.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. Refer to manufacturer. This is not stated in the data sheet reviewed (March 2025, Version 01.01).
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.2, and include the records in the project documentation.
